status: declared by the pull request that closes #461 before any score; the six rows, the state threshold and everything reported are fixed here and are not tuned on a scored day; the judge, its bar, its cut-off rule and every published declaration are unchanged

rows.rule: the six best candidate rows of Table 1 of docs/pivot/judge-amendment-result.md, by the reading #429 declared for 'best' (the most onsets flagged at lead of at least 1, ties broken by the smaller worst false alarms per onset, then by name; the three reference rows left out), extended from five rows to six; tests/test_regime_thresholds.py re-derives them from Table 1

scarce_cutoff.state_reading: the as-of reserve_scarcity_state at the day's decision instant (the judge grid's scarcity_state label); a day whose state is unknown is not scarce
scarce_cutoff.choice: pressure_judge.select_cutoff, the judge's cutoff_rule unchanged (highest onset recall whose false alarms per onset are at most the limit; of equal recall the highest), on the refit's training days whose state is at least 2 and on no other day; a window with no onset in that state flags nothing (never_flag)
scarce_cutoff.other_days: keep the cut-off chosen on all training days, as the judge chooses it today

reported.judge_rows: for each of the six rows, the judge's full row under the pooled cut-off (the baseline) and under the scarce-state cut-off: episodes warned at lead of at least 1, false alarms per episode, tiers 3 and 5, split by regime
reported.weighted_rule: the weighted-miss rule of #454 has not merged when this is declared; the unweighted rule only
reported.onset_recall_by_year: onsets and onsets flagged at lead of at least 1 (a flag on the onset day at any horizon 1 to 5) in each calendar year 2018 to 2025, for each row, pooled and scarce-state cut-off; the years 2018, 2020 and 2024 are called out
reported.scarce_cutoff_diagnostics: per row and horizon, the share of refit blocks whose scarce-state cut-off flags nothing, and the scored days in a scarce state
